title: Modern C++ Essentials
description: Write fast, safe Modern C++ (C++17/20). Master references, std::vector, STL algorithms, RAII classes, smart pointers, and generic templates.
outcomes: Write clean Modern C++ using std::string, auto, and range-based for loops
Avoid unnecessary copies with const references (const T&)
Manipulate dynamic collections with std::vector, std::unordered_map, and STL algorithms
Design RAII classes with constructors, member initializer lists, and destructors
Manage heap ownership safely using std::unique_ptr and generic templates
